research.name: ossia score
research.note: Desktop sequencer for interactive shows whose timeline holds node patches, automation curves, triggers and conditional branches in one canvas.

effects: timeline score with nested node-graph patches inside timeline boxes
interactive trigger points and conditional branches drawn as dashed flexible-duration intervals
inline automation curves, waveforms, piano roll and video strips embedded in the same canvas
switchable timeline and nodal views of the same processes
